copy.headline: Cowboys dominate Titans 51-30 as Dak Prescott accounts for 5 TDs
copy.caption: Dak Prescott threw four touchdown passes and ran for a score, and the Dallas Cowboys reached the end zone on their first six drives in a 51-30 victory over the Tennessee Titans.
